Bad Sketches

The two 4-click sketches whose own line passes 0.07 m and 0.04 m from the center gate's west post, flown by the pin at sigma 0 and 0.5, by the plain pi0 with the command carried exactly by velocity projection, and by SDEdit at t0 0.5. Top: mixed-data checkpoints (gmsig3 / scratch3, 100 real + 200 simulated demos). Bottom: real-only checkpoints. 5 trials each.
